info.title: API.SH: Watches.com
info.description: The Watches.com API from API.SH: public Watches.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Watches.com collection (a brand such as Seiko or G-Shock, or a style such as Dive Watches or Gifts): its title and description, and its products with price, compare-at price, discount, availability, SKU, image and tags, plus the filter values with counts. Sort and filter with the store's options. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/watches-collection

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: `true` for in-stock only, `false` for out of stock only.

get.description:
Customer reviews from Watches.com. With `handle` (or `sku`): that product's reviews with its average rating and count. Without: the shop's own reviews with its overall rating. Each review has rating, title, text, date, reviewer (first name and initial in `name`, plus the name and place the store's widget shows in `full_name` and `location`), verified-buyer flag, photos, replies and tags. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/watches-reviews

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Product handle or link for product reviews.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Search Watches.com's watches and straps: product id, handle, title, brand, type, link, price, highest price, compare-at price, discount, availability, SKU, image, tags and dates, with the total and the filter values (availability, price range) with counts. Sort and filter with the store's own options. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/watches-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
